book.title: Protecting the Ozone Layer
book.subtitle: An introductory course on the international legal framework
book.readers: adult learners: officials, students and practitioners new to ozone law; no science background assumed
book.source: Introductory Course to the International Legal Framework on Ozone Layer Protection, course workbook (Ozone Secretariat / UNEP), Markdown copy at books/ozone/source.md
book.use: open web; publishing openly needs the workbook owner's (Ozone Secretariat / UNEP) permission, which the user was told at intake

words: Pilot: Lesson 1. Style: a mix (diagrams that change, with illustrated scenes where they help). Narration in English. For the open web.
Art: flat infographic drawn in code; the molecules are the characters (an O3 trio, a CFC, a chlorine atom that breaks ozone apart); no licensing worries on the open web.

Palette and voice: night-sky board (deep navy fading up to space), UV in violet, ozone in sky blue, ozone-depleting substances in warning orange, a clean sans-serif font, a calm US male voice (Andrew) at a slightly slow pace.
Shared pieces: all five (atmosphere cross-section, UV rays, molecules, globe with polar hole, treaty timeline).
ch01 storyboard: approved as shown ('go ahead').

meaning.ozone: #5cc8ff (sky blue: O3, the ozone layer band, healthy readings)
meaning.ods: #ff8a3d (warning orange: CFCs, halons, chlorine and bromine, depletion)

fonts.math: engine default (chemical formulas set with subscripts: O₃, O₂)

look.notation: Chemical formulas with Unicode subscripts (O₃, CFC-11). Units with a space (10 km, 220 DU). Thousands with a no-break space (100 000). Say 'O three', 'Dobson units', 'kilometres' in narration.

pacing.checks: two or three quick checks inside the lesson, a short practice set at the end built from the workbook's knowledge refresher

scenes.art: flat vector infographic on the night-sky board, drawn in code; no human cast: molecules are the characters (round atoms with a soft highlight, simple eyes only on the chlorine 'villain' and the ozone trio when they act)

cast.name: Ozone trio
cast.look: three sky-blue oxygen atoms in a bent chain

cast.name: Chlorine
cast.look: a larger orange atom marked Cl that knocks one atom off O3 and moves on

cast.name: CFC
cast.look: carbon centre with chlorine and fluorine atoms, orange-tinted

scenes.storyboard: the user reviews the layout sheet before motion in the pilot; later chapters self-check

components.name: atmosphere
components.what: cross-section with altitude scale (km), troposphere / stratosphere bands, the ozone-layer band at 15–35 km

components.name: uvRay
components.what: UV-A, UV-B, UV-C rays that travel down and stop (absorbed) or pass at the depth their type allows

components.name: molecule
components.what: O, O₂, O₃, Cl, CFC built from atoms that can bond, split and move

components.name: globe
components.what: Earth seen over the South Pole with an ozone-hole patch whose area can grow and shrink by year

components.name: timeline
components.what: treaty timeline with gold milestone pins (1985, 1987, 1990, 2016 …) for lessons 2–5

sources: drawn in code only (open web; no third-party images)
